title: Masterful instruction!
text: This class focused on a project of my choice, a vase. Wendy masterfully guided me through the creative process. She offered design ideas, demonstrated how to find and fix cracks, and to finish the item for the next step. A wonderful experience! Eric gives a welcoming introduction and you feel at home in Taller Gingell.
